text: Golden letters appeared on the screen, flashing and beaming. My reflection stared blankly at me from the glass.
People stared at the screen, and the screen stared at me. [i]Was[/i] that me?

name: Maneki
text: Look, everybody! Jackpot! Now, if I can just– get it again, I can pay…!
Positive– zero– negative– uncountable, who even cared?
Someone laughed, or maybe cried. It wasn’t me.
A wide-eyed rabbit entered the parlor.

name: Rabbit
text: Wow! I’ve never been to pachinko before.
Maneki turned toward the rabbit, his mouth moving on its own–
